#949 1 2004-09-25T14:28:10Z 7!
Hello! Here is where you can get Icy Tower 1.2 with CUSTOM characters!
"Harold the Homeboy and his friends has decided to climb a huge tower they found the other day. It's up to you to help them get as high as possible without falling down, and collect extra score by doing cool moves on the way.

Icy Tower is a fun and short, yet addictive game where your only goal is to gain as much score as possible. The game brings you custom characters, unlockable floors types, replays to share with your friends, lots of combo rewards and more!"

TO create custom characters:
"HOW TO MAKE YOUR OWN CHARACTER

To make your own character you need three things. Frames (images of
the moves that the character can do), sounds (what the character can
say (and music)) and finally a script that tells the game what is what.

The sounds and music are optional, and does not have to be created.


CUSTOM CHARACTER CREATION GUIDE

Start by coming up with an idea for your character. It might take some
time to come up with a good one, but that's how it is. The whole process
will be a lot easier if you have planned what to do before hand.

Now, first make a copy of the directory named 'template', but call it
the name of your character instead. Enter the directory and rename the
file 'template.txt' to whatever you called your character.

Example: if you renamed the directory to 'jolly_joe', the new name of
the text file should be 'jolly_joe.txt'. This is very important, if
the directory and the text file don't have the same names, it wont
work. (Make sure you can see the file extensions on the files, or
you might do something wrong.)


CHARACTER GRAPHICS

Let's start with the graphics. First off, since the graphics in Icy
Tower is palette based, you need a paint program that can handle
palettes. Not all programs can handle palettes, but here's a list
of a few programs that can:

Graphics Gale
ProMotion (from Cosmigo)
NeoPaint
Autodesk Animator

Once you have started your paint program, locate the directory you
created above and open the 'template.pcx' (or .bmp) file that is in
there.

You will see 15 frames containing outlines of Harold. Below each
frame is a short description. Here's a more informative description
of the frames:

IDLE1 - 3 These frames are the animation that Harold
performs when the player isn't moving him.
The sequence for one cycle is 1-2-1-3. Then it
restarts.

WALK1 - 3 This is Harold's walk animation. You have three
frames to play with, they will be flipped in
the game when Harold changes direction.

JUMP1 - 3 These are the frames used when Harold makes a
medium jump. They show his way up, hanging in
air and down. They will also be flipped if needed.

JUMP The frame for the normal straight up jump.

CHOCK The frame shown when Harold is close to scroll
off the screen.

ROTATE The frame used for Harold's cartwheel jump.

EDGE1 - 2 The animation Harold performs when standing on
an edge.


There you go, now you know how the frames will be used. Start
overdrawing the frames of Harold with your own character. Don't forget
to save!

A note on using a palette based program. You cannot use just any colors,
you only have 256 color to your disposal and half of them are already
used by the game. Open up a view of the palette, you will see a large
chunk of cyan colors (color 144 - 223). These are unused and I suggest
you use them for your character. (Ie you can change them into any color
without affecting the game.

Be warned! If you change a color outside the cyan chunk, it will affect
the game. If you know what you're doing you can create special
environments for your character, but if you don't you will mess up the
game. Caution is advised!

Finally, save your character as either bmp or pcx in the directory you
created. Make sure you save in 256 color (8bpp).


CHARACTER SOUNDS

This is not so hard as the graphics. Icy Tower characters use simple
wav-type samples. You'll need eight for full customisation, but you
can skip those you don't want.

Here's a list of the sounds you can make.

greeting played at the beginning of a new game
jumplo played at a small jump
jumpmed played at a medium jump
jumphi played at a high (cartwheel) jump
edge played when standing on an edge
death played when the character falls off screen
pause played when the game is paused
bgmusic played as background music (looped)

Create the sounds using the sound recorder/editor of your choice and
save them as wav. You can name them whatever you want, but the names
above are easy to remember. Put them all in the directory of your
character.


CHARACTER SCRIPT

Finally you need to create a small text file that describes how the
resources you have created are to be used.

Open up the text file previously named template.txt. (Now it's named
'the_name_of_the_character.txt', remember?

Most of the information is all ready filled in, but here's how it works.
The game will look for keywords, and then load whatever that is written
after the keyword. For instance, the line

[frames] harold.pcx

will tell the game to use the file harold.pcx when it looks for what
frames to use.

The other keywords are: [jumplo], [jumpmed], [jumphi], [edge],
[greeting], [death], [pause] and [bgmusic]

A sample script file could look like this:

# graphics
[frames] template.pcx

# sound
[jumplo] jump_lo.wav
[jumpmed] jump_mid.wav
[jumphi] jump_hi.wav
[pause] wazup.wav
[death] falling.wav
[greeting] yo.wav
[edge] edge.wav
[bgmusic] bg_menu.wav

As you see, [frames] is the only keyword that has to do with
graphics, all the others has to do with sound. See the section above
on which sound that is played where.

After each sound keyword, the name of the sound that should be played
should be written.


PUTTING IT ALL TOGETHER

Now you should have a created a directory named 'my_character' (or
whatever you called it) in the characters directory. In it there
should be an image with the frames, the sounds you want to use and
a text file with the same name as the directory (plus .txt).

If you think you're all set to go, start up Icy Tower and select
your character from the game options. If something is wrong with it,
you will get messages during start up. Good luck!

(If it doesn't work as planned, check the file log.txt that is
created when you run Icy Tower, you might find clues there.)"

HOw to download a custom character: "Simply copy the extracted character folder holding the new character into the icytower1.2/characters/ folder and you're done! If you managed to install the new character correctly, it will now show up under GAME OPTIONS in the game. "

"What in the world is going on?" I asked. Then I decided to bravely punch the tree to see if it was real. As it turned out, it was simply a cardboard replica of a tree. I decided to continue in my quest to find The Tree, which I had been looking for. After a few days' search, I found it. It was a beautiful, golden tree, with apples of silver essence. I knew immediately what I had to do with The Tree. I took some seeds from its' silvery fruit and would plant them back home. Unfortunately, some foreboding and ominous clouds had begun to creep over. The jaws of darkness tried to snatch me, but... "roll of thunder, hear me cry." I thought of that, but knew that that was just another fragment conjured up by my demented cilantro brain. I escaped from Dark, and reached a cave. I hid in it until the danger had passed. But my troubles weren't over yet. Trogdor was on a rampage!!! I knew there was only one thing that could be done in the face of such a trerrible threat. Knowing the old aphorism, "If you can't beat 'em, join 'em", I joined Trogdor and together burned down a bunch of villages. Then some strong muscular warriors came and beat me up. Then Trogdor burninated all the evil nasty men. Then the yellow and red armadillos from The Sliding Foundation arrested the evil cardboard tree. Firstt off, I'm using PS CS2

I love doing this. FIrst, make a new image, (any size over 200x200 for best effect).
We'll use 500x360. Select a foreground ccolor to any color you like. I'll use blue here. For the background color, change that, too, into any color. We'll use red. Now go to "Filter," then "Render," and select "Difference Clouds." Hit "Ctrl+f" if you do not like the pattern. The colors don't come out good at first, but keep "ctrl+f-ing" and you'll get something you like. Now, go to "artistic," then "Paint Daubs." Change the settings to this: Brush size=anything greater than 30, (I used 40). Sharpness=36. Brush type=Sparkle.
Save it and here's what I got.


If you want, go to "Stylize" and hit "Glowing Edges."

#4453 1 2005-09-18T14:26:19Z 7!
Requirements: Windows 98/Me/2000/2003/XP

You ever wanted to change whom the PC is registered to and change to manufacter logo? Here's a neat way.
First, create a new text document anywhere. Rename it to OEMINFO.INI.
Add this:
[General]
Manufacturer=Your Manufacturer
Model=Model #

Save the .INI and in XP/2000, move it to
%windows directory%/system32
In 98/me, it is
%windows directory%/system
If you want to add a picture, get your picture/make one. It has to be no larger than Height-114 pixels and Width-180 pixels.
Save it as OEMLOGO.bmp, (IT MUST BE IN A BMP FORMAT). Move it to the same directory where we moved OEMINFO.ini, (depending on your OS).

How to edit your name and organization.
Go to start, hit run, type "REGEDIT," and hit enter.
Go to:
HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion
Now on the right panel, you'll see many objects. Look for the objects
"RegisteredOrganization." Right click it, hit modify. FIll in anything you want for that and hit "OK."
If you want to change your name, go to
HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion
and right click the object "Registered Owner."
Change it to whatever you like, and hit "OK."
Exit out of regedit. No reboot required. Go to control panel, hit "system." You should have something like this:


Did you like the tutorial?

Here's why.

I go to my first period class. We're watching some CSI, (forensic science, what else do we do?). Then he says "shut up." I said "wtf, I waws trying to be nice." He says "I hope your grandfather dies." (Or some random shit like that, he knows my grandfather is hre for the winter). That really pisses me off. Before I can say anything, he says "****** doesn't like you." I said "She and I are just good friends." Let's call ****** "GFOM," (good friend of mine). Then he says, "She sucked my dick last night." That blew it. I said to him "Fuck you, go to hell." I would take care of him during lunch, (7th period).

6th Period math.
I enter the room, talking to GFOM, telling her what happened earlier. Then the kid who made fun of her and me comes in. My math teacher is looking at me, I don't care though, I take his retarded baseball hat and dump it in the garbage. ANd he's dirty enough to take it out and put it back on. I get in trouble by my math teacher, whatever.

7th Period Lunch.
I eat lunch with some friends of mine at our lunch table. Then we all head outside. I see the kid who made fun of me and GFOM, and I tackle him down. Then I spat on him. That's right. I spat on him. He was like "wtf, why'd you spit on me?" I said "You deserved that." Now all these 7, 8, and 9th graders (I'm a 9th grader BTW), come up to me and ask why I spat on him. I say, "Long story, kids, leave me alone." Before I know it, I was being pegged with tennis balls. One bruised my right knee, cut it a little. Then I go inside for a few minutes to escape. I go outside, looking for my backpack, (which I eft out there by the door). It's not near the door. I ask the kid where it is, he says "If you kiss my feet, I'll tell you." I said "Fuck you, no way." I found it, inside out. *Sigh.* I took it back inside and folded it back the right way. GFOM asked me who did that, I told her. Then I go back outside and I'm still pissed off at the kid who made fun of us. He goes up to me, apologizes, he says "I learned my lesson, never make fun of you." I said, "um, wrong lesson, kiddo. Never make fun of GFOM."

I would tell her all this online later that night via AIM.

I went through all that, risking getting suspended, (I tackled him in front of the pirncipal's office and spat on him), getting banged up with a tennis ball, a cut and bruise on my right knee, getting in trouble in math, and actually listening to his shit all because of GFOM.

I told her that I loved her a lot, (as a friend), and told her everything about what he said and what I did to him, etc. I also told her something along these lines: I'll never, ever let anyone harm you in any way, even if i die.

I told her I've always got your back, and I'll always be there for her. Did all of this just because some kid talked badly of her, (but me and her both know him pretty damn well). I told her I'd never let something like this happen again, but if iI had to go through something like this, I'll risk anything to stop it. Anyways, she thanked me a lot, though, and I'm glad I did all of this just for her. That kid surely deserved to be spat on.

Quote: macaddict_17, Jan 13 2006, 06:05 PM
Soo... no one wants to list benefits of Windows? I still think one is 'better' than the other. Please, I just need some closure.

Really, can't anyone deeply discuss this?
Windows.

More compatible with hardware and software.
Much more users.
Has more support for different processors, (AMD, Intel).
If you have the RAM, excellant multi-tasking OS, (2000 and XP).
Integrated MP3 player support for hundreds of "Plays for Sure" MP3 players, (iRiver, Samsung, etc.), (Windows XP Media Center 2005/XP with Windows Media Player 10).
Can be both bought from a manufacturer or built by yourself.

Apple.

Nicer looking OS. I won't lie here.
Faster boot up time than Windows, (Mac OS X 10.4.x compared to both Windows 2000 and XP on 512mb RAM).
Integrated iPod support into OS.
Stylistic design, I guess.

The Cons.

Windows

Some features are hard to turn off, (system restore, Firewall annoys you when trying to turn it off, (SP2 only)).
SLow start up times, (XP, 2000).
Not good under 256mb RAM, (XP only).

Apple.

Can be hard to get used to.
Confusing to navigate through simultaneous windows.
Huge monitor almost a neccessity for OS X 10.4.x.
Cannot be built by yourself.
Pricey.
Most programs ported to Macs from Windows are usually earlier releases. A Mac user may have Windows Media Player 9 for Mac whilst an XP user can enjoy 10, (soon to be 11).
Nowhere as close as compatible with Windows*
Not good under 256mb RAM, (10.x only)


*The fact that Apple introduced Intels to its' newer Macs may change this in the future.

Give credit to Apple for iTunes. IMHO, I like it more than WMP.

Linux, let's see, I don't have much experience with it. And Knoppix doesn't count right? SO there you have it. I'm not saying anything about Linux, but I have heard that it is complicated for the average user.

In my opinion, the winner is Windows.
Mac gets a 8/10. If it were more compatible and less expensive, I'm sure Apple will have a sure-fire WIndows killer. And Apple is getting more compatible, the recent switch to Intel...

Windows: 9/10. Best OS for most things. The reason why I say this is b/c there are many versions of it. The professional edition of XP is great for work/school. Home edition is a good all around OS, and Media Center rocks at music, video and photography. Any version of XP is good for gaming, but Home is the best, b/c it takes up the littliest amount of RAM. Windows loses the point for its bloatedness, (XP only). Too many features in an OS can be very annoying.

Yes, my dad told me to install it for him so that he can see what it's like and if it's worth the upgrade. So far, we found out that we may need another gb of RAM...

The worst an OS can do to your computer is give you an "Operating System not found" or some "*file.extention* is required to start windows and cannot be found." Or if you really screw up, you won't be able to get past the BIOS screen. Just pop in your hard drive's cd and write zero's to the drive. That will fix the hard drive. But for files missing in windows, just try to repair the installation with the windows cd.

HOW TO IDENTIFY YOUR NICK AND CREATE YOUR OWN PASSWORD.

NickServ is pretty annoying IMHO. But I use it to protect my nick. It helps to prevent nick spoofing.

When you first go into irc.phrenzy.org, type "/msg nickserv register *make up a password without these asterisks* *insert your email address without these asterisks*"

Example: /msg nickserv register ABC123 johndoe@yahoo.com

And say, you reboot or something. To identify your nick, type "/msg nickserv IDENTIFY *your password without these asterisks*

Another HOW TO.

HOW TO AUTO-LOG IN (Chatzilla)

Go to Tools, then Options in the menu bar. There will be a list of settings, (Global Settings, then a list of servers you've signed onto). Click the irc.phrenzy.org server. On the right, there will be tabs, General, Appearance, Lits, and DCC. Go to Lists. Under the Auto-perform section, click the "Add" button and type, (exclude the "/"), "msg nickserv IDENTIFY 'password'" without the quotations. Hit Apply, then OK.

Microsoft Windows Entertainment Pack with Tetris

This took lots of hard work to find, so enjoy!
Requires 8mb RAM, 386 PC or better, and 5mb hard drive
space, (Basically will install on any Windows PC running
3.x to Vista).

Installation:

Run SETUP.exe in the Ent Pack1 folder. When it is finished,
copy the "Entertainment Pack One" shortcut provided in the WEP
folder to your start menu folder, (right click the start button,
hit explore, hit Programs, paste the shortcut in there). Default
targets for all shortcuts in the Entertainment Pack 1 shortcut folder
target to "C:\WEP\program.exe"

Run SETUP.exe in Ent Pack2, wait for it to finish. It will copy
shortcuts automatically.

Run SETUP.exe in Ent Pack3, wait for it to finish. It will copy
shortcuts automatically.

Run SETUP.exe in Disk1, wait for it to finish. It will copy
shortcuts automatically.

Compiled by Pavel.

#11239 1 2006-09-14T23:02:02Z 7!
I made an N boot screen to replace your boring Windows XP boot screen.
Limitations: Must be in your WINDOWS directory and be a 16 color BMP...
Here's a video on YouTube: N Boot Screen

And the install instructions:
Save the image in the attachment. Copy and paste it in your /WINDOWS/ directory. Now, go to control panel, folder options, View tab, uncheck "Hide protected OS files" and hit yes, then okay. Go to your C:/ drive, (or whereever your BOOT.ini is), open up BOOT.ini in your favorite text editor. Add the line to your /WINDOWS /FASTDETECT, (/NOEXECUTE might be there too, dw about it), "/bootlogo /noguiboot"

Save the boot.ini, (may be read only, right click the file, properties, uncheck read only, hit ok), then try adding the "/bootlogo /noguiboot" part. Yours should look like this:
multi(0)disk(0)rdisk(1)partition(1)\WINDOWS="Microsoft Windows XP Professional" /FASTDETECT /bootlogo /noguiboot

#296257 119 2007-02-11T17:49:09Z 7!
Quote: Pavel, February 04, 2007 11:29 am
I could go grab Vista if I wanted to. But I'll wait for a Service Pack or something similar comes out...
I completely went against this and installed Vista. It's not really too different. Looks cool, and stable, but really, the highlight of the OS is the whole Aero thing. The Media Center is an improvement over Windows XP Media Center Edition. IE7 works better in Vista than in XP. New games, such as Inkball and apps like DVD-burning are included in the Premium edition.

Doesn't, however, have many drivers for it yet. Especially those with older PC's, don't bother installing unless you know your hardware has Vista drivers. 2000/XP drivers WON'T work with Vista...I tried. Sound drivers are the hardest to find, thanks to Sony and Microsoft and the DRM... if you used Vista, you'll say, "It's XP with some new software and screen savers and new sounds and wallpapers. Not that different." My advice: You don't need to upgrade right now. Actually, you don't need to upgrade. Wait for a few months, unless you get a new PC that has Vista. Installation time took an hour and a half. It copies the files from the DVD to the hard drive then expands them. That's how Vista is installed. This PC is 4 years old, so I bet installation would be faster, but not as fast as XP would...XP usually takes 30 minutes to install.

This 2.4GHz 512mb RAM computer I installed Vista still has XP, (dual boot). Vista is actually a little faster than XP on this computer. I bet, however, if I had an Aero capable video card, it would lag.

Unless you want Aero oh so badly, stick with DOS/3.x/NT3.x/95/NT4/98/Me/2000/XP/2003 for now.

Something I'd like to share to everyone...Some days I feel like, "this world of ours is so shitty" and sometimes I feel like, "Life's great, and the world is my oyster." But the point is, I have some good reasons for both views.

When I feel that the world is horrible, it's because of the things that go on and the attitudes of the people in it. You read, hear and see things like, "Man rapes woman," or "Guerrilla warfare breaks out in some country," or "Local man shot 9 times, reason unknown, suspect identified." Things like this happen everyday, all over the world. And I realize now that in the real world, not our glamorous life which I'll go into later, that no one will really care about anyone else and you gotta get independent since no one will do your shit for you...There are so many people, including politicians, that try to bribe for their own benefit, use mass corruption, and just too many people are dirtbags.

At the other end of the spectrum, life can be great. When you're with your friends, and having a good time you don't care about anything and just have fun with them. When you listen to music, most of the time you enjoy it, most of us have good days in schools almost everyday since we socialize with one another and I think that many of us get along well and I clearly know that some do not get along at all...I think that everyone really should just sit down for a moment and think how lucky we are to be in good countries and cities/towns and live a wealthy lifestyle, not having to worry where we'll sleep tonight, (unless you're into sleepovers a LOT), or not worrying about where our next food is coming from, but rather we have choices...most of the world is still stuck in poverty, so keep that in mind. And you gotta keep your head high, don't be a sellout or a sucker for the ones who try to take advantage of you or talk about you behind your back...

With all that, well, welcome to this world.

I was fortunate enough to talk to Philadelphia Flyers goalie (#30) Antero Niittymaki on AIM...here are the questions and answers.

Interview with Philadelphia Flyers netminder, Antero Niittymaki

Me: if the flyers played a better defensive game, i'm sure you'd be up there
Antero Niittymaki: yea we're struggling a lot this year.

Me: when you were young who were your idols
Me: hockey idols that is
Antero Niittymaki: just finnish goaltenders, i dont think theyre well known in the us

Me: what's the hardest team to face, in your opinion
Antero Niittymaki: i dont think there's a hardest team to face. some teams are bad because we haven't won in so long or have such a bad record against, like tampa bay, but every game is a new try and some teams might be easy at one point in the season and really hard at others it all depends

Me: did you really sneeze when the camera focused on you during a game
Antero Niittymaki: its just the cold gets to me. i also move my head around to keep it stretched out a lot too.

Me: could you tell me about the overtime goal you scored for the phantoms in the AHL?
Antero Niittymaki: that was hilarious
Antero Niittymaki: so it was the end of the season
Antero Niittymaki: we were playing the bears
Antero Niittymaki: they're the other pennsylvania team so we have a big rivalry
Antero Niittymaki: anyways it was tied going into overtime
Antero Niittymaki: and the bears needed to win the game to make the playoffs
Antero Niittymaki: so they pulled their goalie. in overtime. not too smart. but they did it.
Antero Niittymaki: anyways it was 6 on 4 cause they had a powerplay
Antero Niittymaki: and pulled the \goalie
Antero Niittymaki: and so theytook a shot and i blocked it
Antero Niittymaki: and it managed to bounce off the boards just right and go into the empty net at the other end
Antero Niittymaki: and sincei was the last one to touch it
Antero Niittymaki: i got the goal
Antero Niittymaki: how great is that
Me: that's sick
Antero Niittymaki: i mean i wasnt trying to get it in, i was just making saves but thats how it happened
Antero Niittymaki: it was pretty funny none of us knew what had happened for a second

Me: i don't think there's that many good rookie tenders in the nhl this year
Me: last year, there were many good ones
Me: lundqvist, miller, you, emery, the list goes on
Antero Niittymaki: that's cause of the lockout
Me: true.
Antero Niittymaki: i mean we're all talented but that year off definitely gave us a leg up just like ovechkin got a leg up on crosby
Antero Niittymaki: man i hate that kid
Antero Niittymaki: always scoring goals on me
Me: i was wondering what if there was ever a crosby-lemieux-jagr line
Antero Niittymaki: that would be sick
Me: yeah
Antero Niittymaki: i wouldnt wanna play against that
Antero Niittymaki: haha

usaswim in Vista, go to control panel, add/remove programs. There might be a "uninstall windows vista" if you upgraded. Not too sure, since I did a clean install of Vista. If it's not there, then...grab an XP CD somehow and follow these steps...

1. Backup, backup, backup (in Vista, burn your music, photos, N sol file, etc. to CD's or a DVD)
2. Reboot and Boot to your XP CD-ROM
3. Start the Recovery Console
4. Type Fixboot
5. Type fixmbr to reset the master boot record
6. Exit the Recovery Console
7. Reboot
8. To remove the extra entry, edit the boot.ini file to remove the "Microsoft Windows Vista" entry.
9. Format Your Vista Partition

On another note, I voted for Windows 95. 3.x is too outdated and 95 is almost as simple and faster.

#339907 9 2007-07-07T14:00:18Z 7!
Stop whining about UAC. If you have administrator rights, it's easy to turn off.

Go to control panel. Switch to classic view. Go to User Accounts. Click Turn User Account Control On or Off. Uncheck the box "Use UAC to help protect your computer." Hit ok.

Go back to control panel. Click Security Center. On the left pane, click Change the Way Security Center Alerts Me. Click Don't notify me and don't display the icon. It says "Not recommended," but I recommend it because it disables those persistent popups about "UAC is turned off. No anti-virus software found," etc.

I wrote this down in some other thread.

Go to control panel. Switch to classic view. Go to User Accounts. Click Turn User Account Control On or Off. Uncheck the box "Use UAC to help protect your computer." Hit ok.

Go back to control panel. Click Security Center. On the left pane, click Change the Way Security Center Alerts Me. Click Don't notify me and don't display the icon. It says "Not recommended," but I recommend it because it disables those persistent popups about "UAC is turned off. No anti-virus software found," etc.

Hello all. Today marks my 3 year anniversary at the Metanet Forums and community. I never expected to stay here for this long and I certainly didn't intend to when I first joined. When I first played N it was extremely frustrating. I eventually beat it in the Summer of 2K5. I became involved in NUMA and I was at one point in the top 10 most maps in NUMA for a while. I haven't made a map in a year however. One of my earliest posts was in a thread which contains one of the most famous Tsukatu rants.

This is my first post.
RANDOM MAP thread which contains a legendary rant.

I had a rough start on the forums. At first I was kinda scared of the whole community, and then eventually it would be that I would only be scared of Brickman and Tsukatu. Those were my n00b days as I regretfully recall and I was the laughing stock of the forum. STill, I created friendships with LittleViking and Kablizzy, (he registered shortly after I did originally, just 10 members after me). There were some times where I would spontaneously leave the forums for a month or two due to school work. One day I think Arachnid created an IRC room for us on irc.mware.ca. Good ol' days where I was 654321. Things got better as I tried to establish myself as a veteran in the community. I would go through a few more nick changes, 7654321, Pavel, and my current one, Vyacheslav. I have installed many OS'es countless times since I joined. In conclusion, I honestly never thought I'd be here for 3 years. I am honored to be a part of this ever-growing community and hope my future contributions to it will be beneficial.

#434009 7 2008-05-05T21:18:09Z 7!
DOS will use your system's internal speaker by default unless you have a compatible (and ancient) sound card like me, (Creative Sound Blaster AWE64 ISA). ISA is a type of card bus before PCI and AGP.

Firefox, IE, Netscape, Opera, etc. are web browsers. HTML and Java are languages. Flash and Shockwave are plugins.

Your scheme on drives is a little off. A: and B: are reserved for floppy drives. C: typically is where your version of Windows is installed. D: through any letter can either be another partition. hard drive, flash drive, iPod, CD/DVD drive, etc. Not everyone's C: drive is larger than their other drives:



BIOS essentially tells your computer how to start it. Does it boot off a floppy, or a hard drive or a CD drive? What resources does your sound and video card use?

In the DOS days, you would have two files that told DOS how to operate: CONFIG.SYS and AUTOEXEC.BAT. Config.sys configures RAM usage and loads drivers into memory. Autoexec.bat basically executes programs in the batch file when you boot into DOS - similar to startup programs.

The Blue Screen of Death is still common. It was very common in the Windows 3.x/9x days. However, in NT, 2000, XP and Vista, they are not as common because they are more stable OS'es than the MS-DOS line. BSODs can still occur in NT:

#20623 1 2008-06-24T16:40:00Z 7!
Isnt it ironic how high school students do things theyre not supposed to when they clearly know that they shouldnt be doing those things? Most high school students have taken a drink of an alcoholic beverage, such as beer or vodka. It is illegal to buy alcoholic beverages if youre under the age of 18 or 21, depending on where you live. Many high school students get wasted and hammered at parties and after prom. But why? Whats the point of drinking? Do kids do it because they think it makes them fit in? Do they do it to think theyre better than everyone else? Do they think that they can have more fun by drinking? Do they think it makes them change their personality? Do they see it as an escape from their personal problems and stress?
Drinking is also a problem in our town as well as in many other communities. Every day in school, I hear stories or plans about kids who want to go to a friends house or a party to drink. I cant stand these sorts of conversations because they absolutely disgust me. They know they shouldnt be doing it and they know the insidious suicide drinking possesses, so why do they look forward to doing it? Everywhere I go, I cant seem to escape from these discussions of alcohol. When Im in school, I hear about it in the hallways, at lunch, sometimes even in class. At home, I am reminded of it on Facebook: in my news feed, I usually see messages from so and so to their friend about how drunk they or their friend was last night. It just doesnt make any sense to me. I find it utterly revolting and disrespectful that students get drunk when one of our fellow class mates was killed by a drunk driver. In United States history, there were several Temperance movements in the mid-to-late 1800s against the consumption of alcohol. During the 1920s, alcohol consumption was ruled unconstitutional by the 19th Amendment. However, Americans in general found means to obtain and consume alcohol, often creating their own whiskey and wine. Millions of Americans also attended speakeasies. This shows that even if drinking is against the law, there are many people who are willing to break the law. However, society and capitalism also contribute to underage drinking. Millions of children watch hockey, baseball, football, and other sports. At professional ice rinks, there are advertisements for Bud Light among the boards. At baseball stadiums, there are billboards for Coors. Most television networks contain beer and vodka commercials. Watch Sports Center on ESPN for an hour count how many beer commercials youll see.
What can you do about underage drinking? You dont necessarily have to sit there like a lame duck. You can join groups such as the Alliance Against Underage Drinking to help spread public awareness of the issue. You can also advise people who are underage drinkers to stop their consumption. Let them know the health damages alcohol has on their body, (such as liver damage and the disturbance of the balance of hormones like testosterone and estrogen in adolescents). You can make a difference. Be responsible and make good decisions.

It starts in some obscure, tiny town, (as where many horror movies take place). There is a beauty pageant being held and whoever wins goes to the state finals. Eventually it came down to 2 girls: One girl who was an orphan and lived in a motel and the other was named Sarah. Sarah lost the contest, but offered to drive the orphan to the motel. It was late, past midnight. Sarah had this burning desire to win the contest and was immensely jealous of the orphan for winning. She put chloroform under the orphan's nose and she passed out. When she awoke, she was tied up with ropes, mouth shut with duct tape. Sarah started screaming at the orphan, "WHY DIDN'T I WIN? I WISH I WAS AS BEAUTIFUL AS YOU ARE..." She pulls out a knife and starts mutilating her. She's bleeding all over the place, still alive. Then she starts using the knife to make her orgasm, (meaning fistfucking her with the knife in her hand). She orgasms and dies. Sarah pours maggots and earthworms all over the orphan's body. She buries the body in a grave she made beforehand. She takes a shower somewhere and then drives back to her home. The next day, she is confronted by policemen and smashes one of their faces with a hammer. She then proceeds to kill herself. Her last words were, "Bury me... now." So the policemen buried her.
Then the police are investigating the orphan's death and searching for her corpse. They never find it. A few months pass. Then the movie switches scenes to the graveyard where Sarah was buried. She rises from her grave, green, decomposing, and filled with maggots, cockroaches, worms, and other vile creatures. Her voice turned from a normal, female voice to a Cookie-Monster-like growl.
